title: A read-only `node scripts/review-freeze-fingerprint.mjs --check` in the worktree voids a carried gate's credit, though the review procedure requires it after a fan-in
outcome: A command that provably did not change the worktree does not refuse a carried gate's credit, and the required freeze check can run while a gate is carried
acceptance: A read-only `node scripts/review-freeze-fingerprint.mjs --check` in the worktree voids a carried gate's credit, though the review procedure requires it after a fan-in is done
